input.quote: 13.5 SFJ Representation, Warranty and Covenant. SFJ hereby represents, warrants and covenants that it will have, as and when needed, sufficient funds to satisfy its obligations hereunder.
input.rationale: SFJ performs real work under this Agreement (it is sponsor in the SFJ Territory and conducts the Clinical Trials there under §§ 2.2.1–2.2.2 and 3.1.5), but its only warranty is the funding representation in § 13.5. There is no express warranty that SFJ's activities will be performed to a professional standard and no warranty remedy; § 3.1.5 is only a Commercially Reasonable Efforts covenant to follow SFJ's own SOPs, and § 13.6.2 disclaims all warranties except those set out in Article 13, so nothing in Article 13 stands behind SFJ's performance. That fails the fallback (a performance warranty with re-perform/repair/refund remedy) on both the warranty and remedy elements. The software/deliverable conformance and malicious-code limbs of the preferred position are not applicable to this co-development structure, so we made the smaller, deal-appropriate edit: a professional-and-workmanlike warranty tied to the Protocol, SFJ SOPs, GCP and Applicable Laws, with re-performance at SFJ's cost (not chargeable to Development Costs). The mutual disclaimer of trial-outcome warranties in § 13.6.1 is appropriate and benefits PB, so it is left intact, and the Article 13 carve-out in § 13.6.2 automatically preserves the new warranty.

proposal.summary: Add an SFJ performance warranty (professional and workmanlike, Protocol/SOP/GCP/Applicable Laws) with a re-performance remedy at SFJ's cost in § 13.5.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] SFJ's only substantive warranty is that it will have sufficient funds, yet SFJ sponsors and conducts the Clinical Trials in the SFJ Territory, so we have added a performance warranty for the activities SFJ actually performs plus a re-performance remedy at SFJ's cost. This tracks our playbook position that the party performing the work stands behind it to a professional standard; the existing Article 13 carve-out in § 13.6.2 preserves it against the disclaimer.

ops.newText: 13.5 SFJ Representations, Warranties and Covenants. SFJ hereby represents, warrants and covenants that (a) it will have, as and when needed, sufficient funds to satisfy its obligations hereunder; and (b) all Clinical Trials activities and other obligations performed by SFJ or any Permitted Third Party utilized by SFJ hereunder will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by suitably qualified personnel, consistent with industry standards and in accordance with the applicable Protocol, the SFJ SOPs, GCP and all Applicable Laws. In the event of any breach of the warranty in clause (b), SFJ will, at PB's request, promptly re-perform or otherwise correct the affected activities at SFJ's sole cost and expense, and the costs of such re-performance or correction will not be included in Development Costs or credited against SFJ's funding obligations hereunder. The foregoing remedy is in addition to, and does not limit, any other remedy available to PB under this Agreement.
